classes.description: An encoding participant that may occupy instrument or actor roles under a selected interpretation. Its configuration does not imply a desire, awareness or autonomous goal.

fields.description: Declared integer codec quality setting. Its supported range and effect are defined by the caller-owned runtime profile.

classes.description: The selected image document under an explicit identity rule. entityKey identifies this domain entity; a shared path or filename does not establish identity.

fields.description: Caller-selected stable identity for the image document in this model.

classes.description: A declared finite image observation projection at one measurement boundary: identity, byte length, dimensions and content digest. This is not an eventcore:StateSnapshot, a completeness declaration for all physical facts, an exact Delta or authenticated observation.

fields.description: Declared measured byte length; absent observations are not represented by zero.
Declared SHA-256 digest of the measured content. Format, byte binding and truthful measurement require a separate consumer check.
ImageDocument identity to which these declared measurements refer.
Declared measured image height in pixels.
Declared measured image width in pixels.

classes.description: Declared reencoding action and constraints for the selected image. The command describes requested behavior; its presence does not establish execution, completion or goal satisfaction.

fields.description: Declared action kind. The bounded pilot names jpeg_reencode; the generated primitive schema does not admit or execute an action enum.
Declared dimensions constraint: preserve or resize. No automatic visual acceptance or preservation proof follows.
Declared identity mode: in_place preserves the selected entity; copy creates a separately identified result. The selected runtime profile decides supported modes.

classes.description: An explicit application criterion over supplied image measurements, not a performed action or an attributed mental stance. Its evaluation belongs to the selected runtime profile.

fields.description: Declared quantity: reduction is before.byteLength minus after.byteLength; final_size uses after.byteLength.
Declared comparison: at_least, exactly or at_most. Each has a distinct meaning; no comparator substitution is permitted.
Declared missing-input behavior: unknown when supplied information cannot decide the criterion. Missing measurements never become zero or an empty Delta.
Declared nonnegative byte quantity used by the selected basis and comparison. Human units must be converted explicitly before supplying bytes.

assumptions.text: Examples/intent-preservation defines supported combinations, validates observations and evaluates the criterion. The package alone does not execute these policies.
ImageState supplies only the named image measurement projection; absent values require absent states or source-only descriptions.

invalidationTriggers.text: Review and version the consumer profile and this draft before changing the image identity rule, supported action, quantity basis or comparison semantics.

policies.text: Package compilation and generated SDK checks cover declaration consistency and primitive object shapes. String enums, cross-object identity, image dimensions, digest binding, exact observations, goal arithmetic, implementation correspondence and runtime behavior are not enforced by this package. The separately reviewed Examples/intent-preservation consumer owns the bounded executable profile. Existing InstanceGraph profiles do not implicitly admit imagepilot nodes.

The bounded action kind is jpeg_reencode. Dimensions preserve requires equal declared before/after width and height; resize is a separate declared mode and must not silently replace preserve. Encoder quality is a configuration input, not measured size, visual acceptance or proof of a desired result. Supported integer quality bounds and actual codec behavior belong to the selected caller profile.

For basis reduction compare before.byteLength minus after.byteLength with targetBytes; for final_size compare after.byteLength. Interpret at_least as >=, exactly as equality and at_most as <=. targetBytes is nonnegative and expressed in bytes. Missing data yields unknown only when available observations cannot decide the selected criterion; a known-false conjunct may establish not_satisfied despite unknown other operands. Operation completion and goal evaluation remain separate. No missing measurement becomes zero, a fabricated observation or an empty Delta.

ImageState is an application measurement projection, not an admitted complete physical StateSnapshot or actual event Delta. Source-only descriptions may omit states rather than invent measurements. A desired condition, runtime success message, source quotation or reviewed claim does not establish factual truth, actual change, causation or mental state. Selecting a SizeGoal does not automatically create an agencycore:GoalHypothesis, motive or awareness attribution.

The selected action targets the selected ImageDocument. In_place preserves its entity identity across the declared before/after measurements; copy requires a distinct result identity and explicit derivation outside this minimum package. A path, label or hash alone does not select the identity rule. An image measurement must not be rebound to another document to satisfy a goal.

relations.description: Optional actor/view context. Derive a resolved subject through the selected AgencyContext and its existing actor role; absence remains unresolved. Role scope needs separate consumer validation.
Encoding participant used by this action. Actor versus instrument is determined by the selected interpretation, not by this link alone.
Explicit criterion selected for this bounded action. Its existence does not establish achievement or an operator's psychological goal.
The image selected for this declared action. A codec result for another entity does not fulfill this target binding.
Document to which the observation projection is attributed. entityKey agreement, measurement provenance and before/after placement are consumer obligations.
